hooks.command: input=$(cat); fp=$(printf "%s" "$input" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); base=$(basename -- "$fp" 2>/dev/null); case "$base" in .env*) jq -n --arg reason "Blocked: $base is a secrets file. CLAUDE.md requires secrets to live only in environment variables, never touched directly in a Claude Code session. Use \"vercel env\" instead." "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PreToolUse\",permissionDecision:\"deny\",permissionDecisionReason:\$reason}}";; *) exit 0;; esac
input=$(cat); fp=$(printf "%s" "$input" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$fp" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx) npx eslint "$fp" 2>&1 | head -100;; esac; exit 0
